## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- 🚀 **Give a coach whose school said no somewhere to go next.** A denied school affiliation ended at a "Denied" panel telling them to try a different school or contact the administrators, with nothing on it to act on. The two chapter-type cards come back instead: the school-approved one carries "Your school didn't approve this chapter. You can try again with a new advisor at the same school." and a Try again button, and the community path is a live choice again. ([high-line !1876](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1876)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Moved the application deadline to Sept 30.** ([high-line !1898](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1898)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Tell Gleap where a coach sits in the NTHS funnel.** `fetchNthsData` sends an `nthsStatus` contact attribute, so Gleap can separate an approved applicant who has not created their chapter from one who has, and nudge the first group off the `#nths-group-sidebar-link` anchor. ([high-line !1897](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1897)) *Ben Wheeler*

## Session join under load

The fixes coming out of the Sept 8 investigation into the Sept 3 incident, when the database saturated and students could not get into sessions.

- 🚀 **Cap how hard a failing join retries.** Each join could retry 10 times, and every socket reconnect restarted a fresh 10-attempt budget, so a reconnect wave was a second path into the same storm: Engine.IO connection errors went from 1 per 25 minutes to 308 during the incident. The ack timeout goes from 2s to 10s, since measured p99 join latency is around 8s, `backOff` takes 2 attempts with full jitter so retries stagger, and the reconnect watcher is debounced so a burst of reconnects triggers one rejoin. A `{success: false, retry: false}` response used to leave the client hanging; it now stops the backoff loop, shows the error modal, and fires `SOCKET_SESSION_JOIN_FAILED` with the reason. ([high-line !1895](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1895)) *sammy nave*
- 🎁 **Get the session-change and presence broadcasts out of the join path.** `sessions:join` awaited both before acknowledging, about 479 ms of a 711 ms join. They run in the background now and log their own failures, `sessions:leave` does the same, and `fetchSockets` drops its `backOff` wrapper for a flat 2000 ms timeout instead of inheriting 10 attempts against the adapter's 5000 ms default. That last part also covers deploys: departed containers are expected to answer for 10 seconds, so every join during a business-hours deploy was waiting 5 seconds and failing. ([subway !2929](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2929)) *sammy nave*
- 🎁 **Put the student's grade level back on the session, without the join that made it expensive.** A Sept 3 hotfix dropped `current_grade_name` from `getSessionUsers` along with a join that scanned the whole table, but `CurrentSessionUser` still declares `gradeLevel` as optional, so TypeScript flagged nothing and the two places that read it, the About the session button and the modal itself, had been getting `undefined` for a week. A correlated subquery in the `SELECT` returns it for the two rows that matter, at 0.355 ms against the old 205 ms. ([subway !2909](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2909)) *sammy nave*
- 🎁 **Stop telling the client to retry a join that just failed.** Anything other than a `SessionJoinError` came back as `retry: true`, which told high-line to re-emit `sessions:join` and re-run the same database query, up to 10 times. Once the connection pool filled, waiting queries kept queuing instead of failing and the retries kept adding more. The `retry` field is gone and the failure carries a `reason` instead. ([subway !2926](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2926)) *sammy nave*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🚀 **Added on/off switches for session image uploads, screenshare, and audio calls.** Each is gated twice, since hiding a control does not stop a technical user from calling the endpoint: the upload button and the backend save ([high-line !1889](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1889), [subway !2919](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2919)); the screenshare control, the meeting state machine's `share_screen` guard, and the media-room join ([high-line !1891](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1891), [subway !2920](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2920)); the Talk button and that same join ([high-line !1892](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1892), [subway !2921](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2921)). A blocked request comes back as a new `UnauthorizedFeature` error, a 403 reading "You are not authorized to use this feature". Nothing is blocked today: all three switches are off, each staged so the "Dogfood Eaters" cohort is blocked first when one is turned on ([`block-session-image-upload`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/872139), [`block-screenshare`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/872959), [`block-audio-call`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/872966)). These are kill switches, not experiments, and the code says so: they are never to be removed as part of a launch. *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Send Claude a 1024px image for moderation instead of a 224px one.** Claude's own vision guidance warns about degradation around 200px and we were sitting under it. The cap is 1024px on the long edge with a 256px floor, so a tiny upload is not shrunk further, and it covers session images, assignment uploads, contextual moderation, and everything else calling `/moderate/image`. It will be more sensitive, so false positives need retuning, and it costs some latency. ([subway !2917](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2917)) *Chris*
- **Retire the deprecated image-upload-URL route:** 🚀 the frontend call ([high-line !1885](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1885)); ✅ the route itself ([subway !2914](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2914)). The old flow moderated an image, handed the client an upload URL, and let the client do the upload, so once it held the URL it could upload any picture it liked. The backend uploads straight after moderation now and nothing needs the URL. *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Track who is online right now, by role.** Redis sorted sets of online student, volunteer, and teacher ids, kept in step with the existing presence keys through keyspace expiry notifications, each member carrying its own staleness deadline as a fallback for the case where a subway server dies mid-lifecycle. `getOnlineUserIds` has no caller yet; it is there for a study of who is online. The mobile app does not send presence tracking, so those students will not show as online. ([subway !2903](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2903)) *sammy nave*
- 🧪 **Ask students whether they want a coach who has already done the thing they are trying to do.** A fake door: the student dashboard's welcome banner is replaced by a widget asking who they want to talk to, offering "has the career I want", "went or is in my target college", "majored in what I want to major in", "took the class I'm in", and a free-text "something else". Picking one leads to a page saying we have not built this yet, with a link to a short survey and an invitation to a paid interview. The survey URL arrives in the flag payload, so it can change without a deploy. Reaches 5% of students who are not attached to a school partner ([`volunteer-relevant-experience-fake-door`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/877504)). ([high-line !1896](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1896)) *Trey Stevens*
- 🎁 **Match the questionable-link tool schema to the type its consumers actually use.** The schema was wrong, which cost nothing while Haiku 3 ignored it. Haiku 4.5 does not. The details are nested properly now, and the prompt can drop the interim instruction shouting at the model to follow the prompt schema rather than the tool-use one. ([subway !2927](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2927)) *Chris*
- ✅ **Record when a student picks a subject and when they continue with it.** Reviewing the async essay review experiment, treatment and control could not be compared: students who requested a live session were visible and students who submitted an async review were visible, but students who chose a subject and then walked away were not. The events are not specific to async review. ([high-line !1890](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1890)) *Trey Stevens*
- ✅ **Let a session error carry the message the user should see:** `StartSessionError` and `SessionJoinError` became `CaughtError` instances, which already require a user-friendly client message ([subway !2923](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2923)); `SessionErrorModal` uses that message instead of matching on the error text, so a new error condition no longer means remembering to update the client ([high-line !1893](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1893)); and an unapproved volunteer is refused when joining a session, which a technical user could otherwise do ([subway !2924](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2924)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 👀 **Move moderation types out of a Postgres enum and into a lookup table:** the `moderation_type` table, seeded with the existing `contextual` and `realtime_image`, and the unused `moderation_penalty_config` table dropped with it ([subway !2931](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2931)); `moderation_settings` pointed at the table ([subway !2932](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2932)); the generated `ModerationSettings` query types regenerated, since the parameter is a string now ([subway !2933](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2933)); and `image_upload` added as a type ([subway !2934](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2934)). Adding a moderation type stops being an enum change. *Kasozi Wilson*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Close the mobile user menu, and make Profile in it go somewhere.** On Android Chrome, tapping Profile in the coach menu did not navigate and left the dropdown stuck open, with a refresh or a click outside doing nothing. Switching between student and coach mode left it open too. 🐛 [#713](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/713) ([high-line !1886](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1886)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Replace the expired Slack community invite link.** The sidebar invite had lapsed, so Slack fell back to its domain-restricted signup page and volunteers outside upchieve.org could not join. ([high-line !1899](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1899)) *Chris*
- 🚀 **Move CI off Debian bullseye, which had stopped installing anything:** bullseye left LTS on Aug 31 and its security Release file carried a Sep 7 expiry, after which apt treats the repository as a hard error and `apt-get update` exits 100. On subway the `&&` short-circuited so `postgresql-client` was never installed, surfacing one line later as `psql: command not found` ([subway !2918](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2918)); on high-line `playwright install --with-deps` exited 100, fixed by moving the image to `node:24.15.0-trixie` ([high-line !1888](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1888)). *Alex Lindsay, Ben Wheeler*
- **Let several worktrees run the e2e suite at once:** 🚀 the ports made overridable, defaults unchanged ([high-line !1894](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1894)); 🎁 `e2e:create` ending in `up -d --wait`, so the backend does not start against a postgres still running its seed files ([subway !2925](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2925)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Make the browser back button work on session history.** The URL changed and the view did not, filters applied or not. The same thing happens on the past-coaches page. 🐛 [#720](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/720) ([high-line !1900](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1900)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 👀 **Size the onboarding modal's footer buttons to their own labels.** Every new student and teacher saw them truncated to `Previ…` and `Get st…`. The back button was cleaned up in passing. ([high-line !1860](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1860)) *Iulia Rontu*
